viewing_check: Estimate 60-90, current bid $30 when checked. Real-rabbit Dattner coats on eBay AU sold A$46-280 in the last 3 years, typical about A$130-170, mostly 2025-2026 and prices steady to slightly up. Check size, shedding, skin splits, lining tears and smell in person; condition and size drive the price. Full-length is rarer than jackets/3-4 length. Bulky to post (about 2-3kg).
